title: Structured record validation versus authenticity

title: Applicability authority and explicit rationale
question: Can conditional non-applicability be supported by actual recorded fields without becoming a rights waiver?

limits: Two mandatoryclauses remain toyassumptions,not owneradoption;legal/cultural applicability requires qualifiedreview.

title: Time,version and support validity

title: Multihop delegation and ancestor revocation
question: Can a leafpermission survive ancestor revocation or scope expansion upstream?
contribution: Check everylink of a three-node grantchain,not only theleaf. Scope,expiry,version and knownancestorrevocation are cumulative constraints in the proposedmodel.

title: Stale replicas,leases and clock skew

title: Atomic commit and replay
question: Does a current-looking check remain usable after an intervening change or after its nonce is consumed?
contribution: Separate check,commit,epoch and per-requestnonce. Compare stale-cache and replay alternatives while preserving boundedtrace/atomicprimitive assumptions.
limits: Local atomiccheck-and-consume is assumed,not implemented on distributedservices;no actualnetwork latency/liveness study.

title: Grievance accessibility,privacy and outcomes

contribution: Evaluate processreadiness separately from independently supportedoutcomes. GP31criteria are excerpt-limited inspiration,privacy is an addedprojectconstraint,andactualredress is not simulatedpeople.
limits: No affected-partyconsultation,complaintcase or remedy was performed.2021scholarship critiques process/outcome conflation;not a GAIAeffectivenessstudy.

title: Integrated assurance and limits to cycle counts
